He previously worked as a partner at Little & Co. from 1991 to 2001 and began his career as an associate at Debevoise & Plimpton, holding an LLM from Columbia University.

people.name: Rajiv Dube
people.bio: Rajiv Dube is an industry veteran with over 40 years of experience who served as President of Tata Motors' car business and as an executive director on the group board of the Aditya Birla Group. He is an engineer and holds a postgraduate degree in Business Management.
